name: Toothy AI
one_liner: AI for insurance verification & billing at dental clinics
description: We’re Toothy.ai.  We’re building AI agents for dental practices that handle everything related to patient insurance. The average dental clinic spends over 160 hours a month on insurance tasks like verifying patient policies, billing, and claims processing. Our AI agents automate this entire workflow—including making insurance calls with voice AI—saving clinics time, reducing costs, and ensuring faster reimbursements.

name: HealthKey
one_liner: AI-powered Patient Identification for Clinical Trials
description:
HealthKey helps doctors offices generate more revenue by finding eligible patients for their clinical trials. We match at-risk patients with cutting-edge treatments, ultimately getting patients access to potentially life-changing treatments faster.

Big Pharma pays a lot of money to clinics for each patient they enroll, but finding patients who qualify is an entirely manual process today. We use AI to prescreen doctors’ existing patients against Clinical Trials’ eligibility criteria, making enrollment fast and easy.

name: Agentin AI

description: At Agentin AI, we build Agents that move data and take actions across enterprise systems, like Salesforce, NetSuite and SAP. These agents are difficult to build because each enterprise heavily customizes their systems but we solved that by training our Agents to learn and adapt from failures, applying reinforcement learning techniques we developed.

name: Fira
one_liner: Financial research platform for investment firms
description:
Fira accelerates financial research for investment analysts by instantly searching and analyzing thousands of pages of company filings and earnings reports, delivering source-cited answers and verifiable calculations.

Our mission is to build a comprehensive research platform that integrates seamlessly with internal and external data sources, handles research and analysis, generates investment documents, and automates repetitive workflows. This frees investment professionals to focus on what matters most: building relationships and making strategic decisions.

Protent detects early escalation patterns and predictive threat signals, giving security teams the immediate context they need to prioritize alerts and intervene before situations spiral out of control.

name: OctaPulse
one_liner: CV and robotics to automate quality inspection in fish farms
description:
OctaPulse uses AI vision to automate hatchery QA for fish farms, starting with broodstock phenotyping and juvenile deformity inspection. We cut inspection time from about 5 minutes to under 30 seconds per fish, with more than 90 percent accuracy, so farms advance only high quality fish and waste less feed and labor. Our goal is to bring automation across the entire fish production lifecycle for the $300B aquaculture industry.
